maintenance_led.reason: Sells new fragrance, cosmetics and skincare products (Burberry, BOSS, CoverGirl) to consumers; consumables, not servicing of installed base.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from consumers and retailers like Macy's buying beauty products, not government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through brand launches, licences and sales of its own brands; acquisitions are occasional, not a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Consumer beauty and fragrance products are discretionary; retailers and consumers can easily switch to competing brands.
